messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Problems using renderText for HTML
parts:
Hi

I have successfully got a URL link in ui.R 
e.g  a("@pssguy", href="http://twitter.com/pssguy")

I am keen to do something in server.R where the pssguy is an example of a variable
that produces the same output but am having trouble creating something that works

In server.R
output$twitter <- renderText({
    twitter <- "pssguy" # hardcoded for now
    paste0("a('@",twitter,"', href='http://twitter.com/",twitter,"')")
    })

Then in ui

mainPanel(
 htmlOutput("twitter")
               
  )

But the output is just plain text  
a('@pssguy', href='http://twitter.com/pssguy')
